A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

we have developed a framework for defining security properties of composite systems, and a method of deriving the security properties from the security properties of its components and the security properties of the composition.

we have proposed an approach for defining the systems-level security properties for component based composite systems, and we have shown that the security properties can be defined in terms of both security goals and compositional security properties.
The main takeaway from our work is that

the security properties can be derived in a top-down manner, starting from the security requirements of the end-user, and then going through the compositional properties of the component-based composite system to the required security properties of the components.

the end user of a system needs to know the security properties of the composite system at the system level, whereas the software integrator of a system needs a way to derive the security properties of composite systems at the component level.
